appraisal_events.evidence: comme l'eût fait à l'orchestre quelqu'un qui entretient une figurante... il se plaisait singulièrement... à la cérémonie racinienne; il n'aurait plus pu venir chaque jour le voir courir dans la salle à manger verte et se faire servir par lui comme un étranger; par atavisme d'Oriental il aimait les sérails; se risquant jusqu'aux sous-sols et cherchant malgré tout à ne pas être vu et à éviter le scandale, M. Nissim Bernard, dans sa recherche des jeunes lévites
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator systematically unmasks Bernard's ostensibly poetic, theatrical, and religious fascination with the hotel as a cover for a calculated, furtive pursuit of the young hotel servant (and, by extension, other young men), including manipulating his career prospects and skulking through corridors to avoid scandal; the ironic, exposing frame is clearly narrator-endorsed rather than neutrally reported.

status_effects.explanation: Bernard is locally lowered as the narrator strips away his self-flattering aesthetic and religious pretexts to reveal calculated, self-interested, and manipulative behavior toward a young dependent.
His pursuits are confined to hidden corridors, basements, and back spaces of the hotel, conducted furtively to avoid scandal, marking him as operating outside legitimate, open social space.
